rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Remarks headed 'Opening remarks by the Congress President' at the meeting of the All India Congress Committee, Sirifort Auditorium, New Delhi, 6 April 1998, tell the members: 'You have elected me President of this great organization.'

locator.section: heading 'MEETING OF THE ALL INDIA CONGRESS COMMITTEE / SIRIFORT AUDITORIUM, NEW DELHI, 6 APRIL, 1998 / OPENING REMARKS BY THE CONGRESS PRESIDENT' and the first paragraph after the salutation

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the same remarks the speaker says 'It is with deep humility that I accept this privilege', 'I have come to this office at a critical point in the history of Party' and 'I see it as my primary task as Congress President' to restore the vision of the Congress centenary.

locator.section: first paragraph after the salutation; paragraphs beginning 'I have come to this office' and 'I see it as my primary task'
